s.t:
MongoDB’s mission is to empower innovators to create, transform, and disrupt industries by unleashing the power of software and data. We enable organizations of all sizes to easily build, scale, and run modern applications by helping them modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI.

Our industry-leading developer data platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud database and is available in more than 115 regions across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure. Atlas allows customers to build and run applications anywhere—on premises, or across cloud providers.

With offices worldwide and over 175,000 new developers signing up to use MongoDB every month, it’s no wonder that leading organizations, like Samsung and Toyota, trust MongoDB to build next-generation, AI-powered applications.
MongoDB Engagement Managers are quota-carrying Professional Services Sales roles. Engagement managers utilize customer-facing sales, technical, consulting, and commercial experience to scope, negotiate and close Professional Services opportunities to accelerate and de-risk the adoption of MongoDB by our customers.
As an Engagement Manager, you will be a key leader within the PS team and work cross-functionally with the Sales, Professional Services, and Customer Success organizations to drive professional services sales.
Here are a few informative blogs about the Engagement Management role:
https://www.mongodb.com/blog/post/engagement-management-mongodb-meet-lalitesh-pal
https://www.mongodb.com/blog/post/how-engagement-managers-help-customers-succeed

Understand customers’ overall portfolio of applications and datasets, IT and business priorities and success measures to adapt, develop and design specific digital transformation approaches involving MongoDB technologies
Help transform companies by translating their use-cases, pains, and needs into scoped projects and statements of work
Partner with a best-in-class sales organization and work effectively as a part of a larger team to develop account strategies and plans for the successful adoption, growth, and utilization of MongoDB
Have a solid sense of ownership, driving all deals or technical scopings from inception to closure
Manage the Professional Services pipeline for bookings and revenue forecasts for your region
Expertly articulate the business value of professional services, talking knowledgeably and credibly about service delivery issues, challenges, strategies, approaches, and mitigating risks
Work with our practice team to propagate internal skills and experience through the development of repeatable assets (estimates, proposals, SOWs, templates, tools, case studies etc)
Work with the delivery team to transition any agreed upon project scope and customer expectations to ensure successful project delivery
Proactively seek opportunities to support and mentor other team members and share best practices
Have situational awareness and react appropriately in group settings

A BS degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering or equivalent professional experience
A minimum of 5 years experience in the sale of Professional Services and/or technology solutions at an enterprise software company
Experience as an architect, consultant, project manager, or Professional Services manager
Experience internally positioning and selling professional services
Experience carrying a quota for PS bookings

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.

At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.

As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.

Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

As a Senior Consultant at Veeva, you will help major pharmaceutical and biotech companies organize and manage their customer and product data. You will design and implement Veeva Network MDM to give clients a single, accurate view of their doctors, hospitals, and business partners across multiple sources.

You will act as the lead solution architect and project driver. You will work directly with clients to understand their needs, design the system setup, and lead a small internal team of technical specialists to build and deliver the solution on time.

How You Will Spend Your Time
50% Data Analysis & Solution Design: Meeting with clients, analyzing their data needs, and designing how the software should be set up.
30% Technical Architecture: High-level platform configuration, mapping data flows, and making sure integrations work correctly.
20% Project Leadership: Keeping projects on schedule, managing risks, and coaching junior team members.

Lead Customer Projects: Run software implementation projects from start to finish for global healthcare and life sciences clients
Design Data Solutions: Set up the platform to track healthcare professionals, organizations, and product data. Help clients combine their internal data sources into a single source of truth
Connect Systems: Connect Veeva Network MDM to Vault CRM so sales teams in the field can easily request data updates and view accurate customer profiles
Configure Portals and Widgets: Set up user-friendly dashboards and widgets so business users can easily search and access the data they need
Advise Stakeholders: Run workshops and present your designs clearly to client managers and stakeholders, translating technical data concepts into plain business language
Improve the Team: Help train junior consultants and create reusable templates and guides to make future implementations faster and better

Consulting Experience: 5+ years of software consulting or professional services experience leading customer-facing technology implementations
MDM Software Skills: 3+ years of hands-on experience configuring Veeva Network MDM or a similar major master data management system (like Reltio or Informatica)
Data Tech Basics: Solid understanding of data integration tools, including SQL, ETL processes, APIs, and CSV/FTP file transfers
Project Delivery: Experience working with structured project timelines (like Agile or Scrum) and managing project tasks
Communication: Excellent presentation and writing skills. You must be comfortable leading meetings and managing client relationships
Travel & Education: Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience) and the ability to travel 20-30% for client meetings
Work Authorization: Must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Veeva does not provide visa sponsorship for this role

Prior experience working in or consulting for the pharmaceutical, biotech, or medical device industries
Experience with other Veeva software (e.g. Vault CRM ) or Salesforce.com
Experience using integration platforms (e.g. Informatica or MuleSoft)

2026 habe ich mich dazu entschieden, SpotOn zu gründen. Wir sind ein junges, dynamisches Unternehmen, das sich darauf spezialisiert hat, Unternehmen jeder Größe auf der ganzen Welt dabei zu unterstützen, zu wachsen und die richtigen Leute zu finden. Unser Schwerpunkt liegt dabei auf den Bereichen Construction, Handwerk und Engineering.
Unser Team ist ambitioniert und bringt Durchhaltevermögen sowie eine große Portion Disziplin mit. Jeder von uns hat seine eigene Geschichte, seine Stärken und Schwächen – und genau deshalb wird bei uns jeder individuell gefördert und bekommt die Möglichkeit, seine eigenen Ziele zu verwirklichen.
Jetzt soll und darf unsere Mannschaft weiterwachsen – deshalb suche ich einen Consultant in Köln (mit der Option auf Remote-Arbeit zu einem späteren Zeitpunkt). Ob du bereits erste Berufserfahrung gesammelt hast oder einfach für dich entschieden hast, dass du mehr willst als der Rest – das ist erstmal zweitrangig.
Aufgaben

s.h: Der Job als Consultant bei uns sieht ungefähr wie folgt aus
s.t:
Account Management & Sales: Du lernst bei uns den Kundenkontakt von Grund auf – Cold Calling, Networking, aber auch die Pflege bestehender Kundenbeziehungen gehören zu deinem Gebiet.
Recruiting: Du lernst die HR-Seite aus der Perspektive einer Beratung kennen: Interviews, Assessments, Profiling und Beratungsgespräche.
Projektmanagement: Du arbeitest 360 Grad – das heißt, du übernimmst die Gesamtverantwortung für deine Projekte (sobald du so weit bist). Du betreust sowohl Kunden als auch Kandidaten und stellst am Ende das perfekte Match her.
Qualifikation
Um bei uns erfolgreich zu sein, solltest du Folgendes mitbringen:
Hunger: Das ist ein Sales-Job – wenn du nicht ein bisschen die "Wolf of Wall Street"-Mentalität mitbringst, wird es bei uns schwer. Wir sind alle sehr ambitioniert – die einen träumen vom 911er, die anderen vom Haus auf Bali für Mama und Papa. Jeder hat sein eigenes Ziel – wichtig ist nur, dass du intrinsische Motivation mitbringst.
Sprachliche Fähigkeiten: Deutsch ist ein Muss, Englisch solltest du mindestens auf B2-Niveau sprechen und offen dafür sein, dich eigenständig weiterzuentwickeln.
Disziplin: Die erste Zeit in diesem Job kann hart und anstrengend sein. Wer durchhält, wird am Ende dafür belohnt. Aus eigener Erfahrung kann ich sagen, dass die meisten im ersten Jahr mit einem guten fünfstelligen Bonus rausgehen.
Führerschein: Wäre optimal – Kundenbesuche machen wir meistens vor Ort, oder du fährst die Stopps mit unserem Poolfahrzeug ab.

Ein sehr modernes Büro, Designermöbel und Top-Hardware – wir arbeiten ausschließlich mit Apple-Geräten.
Überdurchschnittliches Gehalt durch verdammt gute Provisionen + Fixgehalt: Wir zahlen dir ein monatliches Fixum, damit du deine Kosten unabhängig von der Provision tragen kannst.
Strukturiertes Onboarding & Mentoring: Du wirst nicht ins kalte Wasser geworfen – erfahrene Consultants nehmen dich an die Hand und bringen dir alles bei, was du brauchst.
Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Wir stehen noch am Anfang unseres Wachstums – eine spätere Führungs- oder Spezialistenrolle ist dementsprechend möglich.
Incentives & Teamreisen: Es gibt regelmäßig die Möglichkeit, dich zu beweisen – dafür haben wir zum Beispiel den 911er-Cup ins Leben gerufen. Einmal im Jahr reisen wir gemeinsam als Team und suchen uns einen coolen Ort für unsere Workation.
Du hast Lust ein Teil unseres Teams zu werden und willst eine Firma mitgestalten? Dann freue ich mich darauf dich kennenzulernen.

About Eucalyptus
We're on a mission to make good health last a lifetime. More than 1 billion people live with obesity worldwide, driving preventable chronic conditions. We're here to build better long-term care.
Eucalyptus is now part of Hims & Hers, the global leader in personalised health and wellness.
Euc is the company behind Juniper, one of the world's largest weight-management programs combining GLP-1 medication with personalised nutrition, movement support, and clinician-led care from prescribers, nurses, health coaches, pharmacists, and dietitians. Our published clinical research shows that our combined clinical and behavioural approach helps patients lose significantly more weight during their treatment with Juniper by four times.

Supporting patients living with obesity across our 5 markets
Received selective NICE endorsement to provide services to the NHS
Tailored our offering to thousands of patients in Australia, the UK, Germany, Japan and Canada.

We’re looking for a Senior Commercial Strategy Analyst to join our Commercial FP&A team. This isn't a traditional "back-office" finance role. You will sit at the intersection of commercial strategy and technical data execution. You’ll be responsible for translating complex unit economics into growth levers, leveraging modern tooling and AI to automate the mundane and focus on the "why."

Commercial Performance Engine: Partner with brand leads to interrogate daily performance. You won’t just report on CAC; you’ll analyze the marginal return on spend across multi-channel funnels.
Advanced Financial Architecture: Maintain and scale complex, driver-based financial models. You’ll be expected to bridge the gap between high-level P&L targets and granular operational data.
AI-Driven Efficiency: Integrate AI and automation (e.g., LLM-assisted data cleaning, Python scripts, or advanced ChatGPT workflows) to accelerate reporting cycles and predictive forecasting.
Unit Economics Deep-Dives: Deconstruct LTV/CAC ratios, payback periods, and cohort retention profiles to advise on capital allocation across different geographies.
Data Synthesis: Work closely with the Data team to ensure our "Source of Truth" is robust, moving beyond static sheets into dynamic, real-time dashboards.
Scenario & Sensitivity Analysis: Build "stress-test" models to evaluate the impact of supply chain shifts, pricing elasticity, and new market entry variables.
Operational Partnering: Act as a financial co-pilot for the Marketing and Operations teams, translating their roadmaps into headcount plans and Opex budgets.

3-6 years of experience in a high-intensity analytical environment. Backgrounds in Investment Banking, high-growth companies or similar are highly valued.
Strong FP&A and commercial finance foundation with experience supporting business performance through financial modeling, forecasting, and strategic analysis.
Experience within D2C, B2C, consumer, subscription , or high-growth commercial environments is strongly preferred.
Strong understanding of commercial and customer metrics including:
CAC (Customer Acquisition Cost)
LTV (Lifetime Value)
Retention and cohort analysis
Revenue performance and unit economics
The "Full-Stack" Analyst: You possess a rare combination of commercial intuition and technical rigor. You can discuss brand strategy with a GM and SQL joins with a Data Engineer in the same hour.
Technical Mastery: Expert-level Excel/Google Sheets is a baseline. Proficiency (or a strong desire to learn) SQL, Python, or data visualization tools (Looker/Tableau) is essential.
AI Native: You are proactive in using AI tools to enhance your productivity, from automating spreadsheet workflows to synthesizing large data sets.
Precision & Speed: You have the "IB-style" attention to detail where every decimal point matters, but the startup speed to ship an 80/20 analysis when the business needs to move fast.
Strong Communication: The ability to turn a sea of data into a 3-bullet-point executive summary that drives action.
Euc is also behind a growing family of digital healthcare clinics ( Pilot, Kin , Software ) across men’s health and well-being, fertility, and skincare.

s.h: Here’s what makes joining Euc unique
s.t:
What’s next - Our goal for the next three years is to support 1 million patients globally to live better for longer. We’re launching into new conditions, demographics, and geographies as we build a truly preventive healthcare ecosystem.
Build something world-changing - We’re on the path to becoming the world’s largest international digital healthcare company. It will be challenging, fast-paced, and deeply rewarding.
Make real impact - You will deliver work that directly shapes patient outcomes and scales evidence-based care across markets.
Accelerate your growth - You will have high ownership, continuous feedback, and dedicated development support.
Join a motivated team - You will collaborate with talented peers to solve complex clinical and operational problems at scale.
What’s ahead in the UK
Invest in your growth – Annual development budget plus 3 days of professional development leave
Work flexibly – Hybrid setup with 3 days a week in our Old Street office, designed for focus and collaboration
Support your well-being – Private health insurance through Vitality or opt for a monthly wellness allowance to spend on what matters most to you
Take time off – 25 days of holiday, enhanced parental leave and work from anywhere 3 weeks out of the year
Join a connected team – A vibrant office culture with regular socials, clubs, after-school sport, and seasonal events
At Eucalyptus, we value individuals from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we embrace the unique qualities each person brings. When you apply, please let us know of any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process.

Celonis is the global leader in Process Intelligence and the pioneer of Process Mining technology. As one of the world’s fastest-growing enterprise SaaS companies, we are changemakers pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

We invest heavily in advanced AI capabilities—specifically our Process Intelligence Graph—to turn data insights into immediate business action. We believe there is a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by placing intelligence at the core of every business process.

Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The UK Value Engineering team is responsible for our largest Fortune500 customers and owns their transformation journey by working on the very frontier of what’s possible with data and AI.

Partnering closely with the Sales team, Value Engineering is responsible for ensuring that the Celonis data & AI platform is deployed to tackle the most strategic business challenges, fits into the right place in our customers’ technology stack and most importantly generates strong ROI through deep and broad deployments.

As a Senior Engagement Manager you are spearheading our mission of data-driven business transformation with our customers by owning their end-to-end value journey. You are their trusted technology & business advisor, helping organisations achieve their strategic goals and realize significant value using the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform.

A Value Engineer has full responsibility for the end-to-end value journey of our customers – landing, expanding, adopting and renewing.

Responsibilities include translating customers’ objectives into value assessments or proof-of-value projects, helping organisations understand where Celonis fits into their IT landscape and AI strategy, building specific Celonis business cases and demos, running value workshops, and engaging with multiple senior stakeholders to deliver value driven results and secure long term partnership agreements.

Your skillset combines a strong understanding of technology at both strategic and practical levels with consulting skills around strategic thinking and program management.

Identify & Frame Value

Discover and translate customers’ strategic priorities into high-impact Celonis use cases
Advise organisations on how Celonis’ platform fits into their existing IT landscape and AI strategy
Build demos and business cases, leveraging industry benchmarks and best practices in order to win new customers
Use hands-on tech skills (SQL/Python) to build out (AI) prototypes to bring the Celonis platform to life for new audiences
Lead the development and communication of the value opportunity and strategic roadmap to C-Level executives.

Realize Value

Facilitate business value workshops and use Celonis to identify and qualify opportunities for process enhancement
Derive improvement measures in core business functions and initiate improvement actions and enterprise-wide change initiatives
Present results and realized value to senior management and C-level executives

Scale Value

Responsible for the end-to-end customer value journey, landing, expanding, adoption and renewing
Build a strategic expansion roadmap for customers embedding Celonis Process Intelligence as a strategic business transformation platform in their organization and therefore drive adoption and expansion
Provide feedback to our product development teams to enhance the Celonis platform and Apps based on new use cases

Data, Analytics, Applications & IT: Good knowledge of Business Software / SaaS applications (e.g. SAP), Hands-on SQL and/or Python skills,, experience in collaborating with IT teams, experience developing dashboards and automations in tools like PowerBI or RPA, knowledge of and experience with AI-powered solutions.

Live for Customer Value: Experience in an analytical role with the objective to demonstrate or secure value through business data analysis, business process improvement and respective Software deployment. Ideally in a customer-facing role in Solution Consulting, Sales Engineering or IT/Management Consulting with a Business Software / SaaS Provider or a Consultancy. Alternatively in an Inhouse role (e.g. Center of Excellence for Data Mining / Analytics / Intelligence) within an Enterprise.

Process Improvement & Value Realization: Experience in identifying use cases for business process improvement and deploying improvement measures, being a change agent and training users/process owners to realize value

Project Management: Experience in planning and managing project scopes, expectations and timelines. You will lead multiple projects across your aligned accounts that will be at different parts of the value journey. Also, you will leverage partners from the Celonis Ecosystem wherever possible.

Executive Stakeholder Management: Experience in preparing and communicating (value) roadmaps and results to stakeholders and management, both internally and externally. Excellent communication and presentation skills in English and sovereign appearance.

Business Domain Expertise: Expert understanding of the Finance and/or Supply Chain domain as well as strategic transformation initiatives (e.g. Shared Services Transformation or System Transformation)

Industry Expertise: Expertise in one or more industries (e.g. Manufacturing, Automotive, Consumer, Retail, Pharmaceuticals, Chemicals) and the ability to develop a deep understanding of industry trends and strategic opportunities

Degree: Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Business Analytics or a comparable technical degree

Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.

Own transformation engagements end to end. Lead strategic transformation engagements at Harvey's largest accounts. Job Description
As our organization continues to scale and evolve, we need strong operational excellence to ensure our teams deliver maximum value efficiently. We’re looking for a smart, independent operator who can combine strategy, analytics, and Technical Project Management execution to help build the next generation of global, AI-first Customer Success.
What makes this role exciting?
Our company has grown from a small local startup into a global SaaS organization, and this role is central to the next phase of that journey. You will help replace fragmented local practices with scalable global ways of working, while still adapting to local market realities.
This is a role for someone who enjoys solving ambiguous problems, bringing structure to complexity, and making things happen across multiple stakeholders. You will have real ownership, high visibility, and the opportunity to help build an AI-enabled Customer Success function from the ground up.
In this role, you are contributing by…
Supporting the design and creation of the global Customer Success function of the future, relating to:
Insights (customer journey customisation, research projects, experimentation)
Productivity (product automations, operations effort optimisation and capacity utilisation)
Best practices (cross-market sharing, external expertise/benchmarks)
Help define, test, and roll out AI-first Customer Success use cases.
Prioritize use cases according to impact.
Ensure they are practical, measurable, and adopted by teams.
Forward thinking in terms of scalability and customer journey.
Independently leading data analytics and modelling with a special focus on Retention and Growth.
Data queries and solid understanding of data management topics (Superset, Tableau, SQL)
Machine learning application (prediction models, clustering, decision trees etc.)
Business/financial modelling (business analysis, forecasting, budget simulations)
Supporting the execution of key strategic projects / initiatives in the markets, working hand in hand with local teams in our DP countries.
Scale results/experiments from one market into global projects
Liaise with in-market stakeholders to align on project direction and status
Act as a TPM for selected initiatives, coordinating stakeholders, timelines, risks, and follow-up.

What will help you thrive?
You have 3–5 years of experience in strategy, operations, analytics, project management, or a related role.
Ideally, a Data Science, Statistics, Math/Physics, CS, Finance or similarly quantitatively oriented educational background

About Anthropic
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

Anthropic is building AI systems that will shape the trajectory of one of the most consequential technologies in human history. That work requires physical infrastructure at significant scale, and building that infrastructure the right way means being a real, long-term partner to the communities where we operate.
We are looking for a Community Engagement Manager in Australia to join our Public Policy team and serve as Anthropic's on-the-ground presence in the communities where our data centres are sited, built, and operated. This is not a communications role or a government affairs role, though you will do elements of both.

It is a relationship role: your job is to make Anthropic a trusted, visible, and valued neighbour, from the earliest stages of site selection through construction and long-term operations.
You will be the connective tissue between Anthropic's Policy and Infrastructure teams and the local officials, community organisations, economic development partners, and residents who have a stake in what we build.

You will surface concerns before they escalate, translate our technical and operational plans into clear local benefits, and build the coalitions that allow us to move quickly and responsibly.

Because Anthropic's infrastructure footprint is still early in its growth, you will also help write the playbook: the processes you build in your first markets are the ones we will use as we expand.
You will travel regularly within your region, up to 50% of the time, and occasionally to other Anthropic data centre markets.

Build a community engagement playbook and repeatable processes that scale as Anthropic's infrastructure footprint grows

We Breathe Life Into Data
At Komodo Health, our mission is to reduce the global burden of disease. And we believe that smarter use of data is essential to this mission.

That’s why we built the Healthcare Map — the industry’s largest, most complete, precise view of the U.S. healthcare system — by combining de-identified, real-world patient data with innovative algorithms and decades of clinical experience.

The Healthcare Map serves as our foundation for a powerful suite of software applications, helping us answer healthcare’s most complex questions for our partners.

Across the healthcare ecosystem, we’re helping our clients unlock critical insights to track detailed patient behaviors and treatment patterns, identify gaps in care, address unmet patient needs, and reduce the global burden of disease.
As we pursue these goals, it remains essential to us that we stay grounded in our values: be awesome, seek growth, deliver “wow,” and enjoy the ride. At Komodo, you will be joining a team of ambitious, supportive Dragons with diverse backgrounds but a shared passion to deliver on our mission to reduce the burden of disease — and enjoy the journey along the way.

Great healthcare technology requires a bridge between technical solutioning and real-world strategy to drive true value. If you thrive at that intersection, Komodo Health is looking for a Technical Engagement Manager to join us in our mission to reduce the global burden of disease
In this role, you’ll serve as a strategic technical lead, bridging the gap between Komodo’s data ecosystem and our customers’ most critical business objectives.

You will lead the end-to-end delivery of our most sophisticated AI tooling—specifically Marmot, our proprietary AI engine—integrating Komodo’s data into the core of industry leading healthcare organizations.

Your responsibility extends beyond the initial implementation as you continue to engineer creative solutions and maintain a feedback loop to ensure that our technology solves real-world patient problems.

Lead with AI: Become the go-to expert on Komodo’s AI capabilities, helping customers navigate the frontier of machine learning in healthcare.
Own the Outcome: Be the primary customer-facing technical resource responsible for ensuring delivery milestones are achieved on schedule. This includes leading requirements gathering, executing hands-on data deliveries, and turning ambiguous client workflows into concrete realities.
Be the Customer Champion: Serve as the primary internal advocate for your customers, ensuring their technical priorities and pain points are understood and addressed by Komodo’s internal product teams.
Orchestrate Internal Collaboration: Act as the central point of contact between Sales, Delivery, Support, and Product to ensure internal teams remain aligned on each customer’s unique technical roadmap.
Operate with Precision: Eliminate ambiguity by establishing a clear source of truth for every project. You will build and maintain the thorough technical documentation, roadmap tracking, and system hygiene required to keep our internal teams synchronized and executing seamlessly.
Influence Change: Proactively identify functional gaps in data or workflow requirements and design the necessary technical "bridges" to ensure a seamless experiences.
Looking back on your first 12 months at Komodo Health, you will have accomplished…
Obtained an understanding of Komodo’s Healthcare Map, platform, and suite of products.
Executed customer product delivery on schedule and at high quality, driving in-depth technical discussions and hands-on data delivery.
Contributed to Komodo’s playbooks and internal knowledge base.

Scope and solution both standard and non-standard workflows to determine the optimal path for delivering client value.
Facilitate detailed data conversations with Komodo’s Legal and Compliance teams, distilling and communicating compliance boundaries to stakeholders.
Identify opportunities for automation and scalability within our delivery workflows to transform repetitive tasks into streamlined, repeatable processes.
Mobilize cross-functional teams (including Product, Engineering, Data, and Customer Success) to swiftly diagnose and resolve technical customer bottlenecks and bespoke requests.

Relentless Coordination: A track record of managing multiple complex, multi-stakeholder projects with high accuracy, proactive communication, and rigorous internal system hygiene.

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity.

World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes.

We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

Celonis Services is the delivery engine of our Celonis Customer Organization, responsible for turning the Celonis platform into measurable, business-critical outcomes for our customers.

In the AI era, our role has elevated: as AI agents like our own Apollo take on more of the technical build, our people focus on the work that drives real impact—understanding our customers' business-critical problems, designing the solutions that solve them, and quantifying the value delivered.

Our Lead / Principal Consultant - Data and AI, who we refer to internally as Deployment Engineers and Deployment Architects, pair deep domain and industry expertise with serious platform mastery and AI-augmented delivery, directing agentic systems while owning the judgment, architecture, and customer relationships that AI cannot replace.

We deliver faster and smarter than ever, and we own the outcome: solution go-live, solution adoption, initial value realization support and the long-term success of our customers.

As a Lead / Principal Consultant - Data and AI (referred to internally as a Lead / Principal Deployment Engineer) you are the backbone of Celonis delivery. You lead the hands-on implementation of Celonis solutions for enterprise customers, combining platform expertise with AI-augmented workflows to deliver high-quality outcomes, fast.

You use Celonis’s AI deployment tools as your primary instruments - directing agents to build data models, generate analyses, and configure operational solutions, while applying your own judgment to validate outputs, adapt to customer context, and ensure business relevance.
This is not a traditional consulting role where you build everything manually. You are an AI-augmented delivery professional: you specify what needs to be built, direct AI agents to execute wherever possible, validate the results, and iterate with the customer. You generate value by understanding the customer’s business, translating their needs into technical specifications and solutions, and ensuring the platform delivers measurable impact.
The Work You’ll Do
Initiate and Connect
Conduct business discovery workshops to translate customers’ strategic objectives into high-impact Celonis use cases
Collaborate with the customer’s IT and business stakeholders to define project scope, data requirements, and success criteria
Ensure data connectivity and extraction pipelines are properly configured, working with specialist resources if required
Build & Value
Direct AI deployment agents (Apollo) to build data models, process analyses, KPIs, and dashboards - writing clear specifications and validating agent outputs against business requirements
Build and configure Celonis solutions across the platform: Process Intelligence Graph, data transformations, process analysis, operational solutions, and AI-powered insights
Identify process inefficiencies and root causes using Celonis technology, always in close collaboration with the customer
Validate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, business relevance, and alignment with customer context - applying domain knowledge where the AI cannot
Lead value creation workshops and define measures to improve process inefficiencies
Define and build KPIs measuring the customer’s success and quantify business impact
Design and build operational solutions to drive value, adoption and improve process conformance
Rollout, Adoption, and Handover
Enable key customer users to use and extend the solution independently, setting the foundation for long-term adoption
Manage project outcomes against timelines, scope, and customer expectations
Train and demonstrate to customer users, guiding them on the path to sustained value
Document solution design decisions and configurations for future reference and handoff
Domain & Industry Depth
Develop and maintain deep expertise in one or more process domains (e.g., Supply Chain, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, IT Service Management) or industry verticals
Translate domain knowledge into scalable solution patterns, reference architectures, and best practices that the broader team can leverage
Proactively identify and standardize high-value use cases within your domain, collaborating with Product and Business Apps teams to shape the platform roadmap
What Makes This Role Different in the AI Era
You work with AI agents as your primary tools - your job is to direct, validate, and refine their output, not to write every line of code or build every analysis manually
You need strong specification and context engineering skills - the ability to translate a customer’s ambiguous business need into a precise instruction that an AI agent can execute correctly
You are expected to continuously learn and adapt as AI capabilities evolve, experimenting with new approaches and sharing what works with your peers
You balance speed with quality - AI accelerates execution, but you own the judgment calls on whether the output is right for this customer
You think in sustainable software solutions. While AI agents will generate first results quickly, you need to ensure that the operational solutions you build in Celonis are robust, user friendly, maintainable, and scalable

Experience: 7+ years minimum in Management or IT consulting, data/solution consulting, or process improvement consulting within software vendors, consulting firms, or system integrators.
Platform skills: Ability to build and configure solutions on the Celonis platform, including data modeling, process analysis, KPI definition, and automation. Proficiency in PQL, SQL, and Python.
AI fluency: Comfort working with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.). Ability to write clear specifications, evaluate AI-generated outputs, and iterate effectively. Experience with prompt engineering or context engineering is a strong plus.
Business and process domain expertise : Strong understanding /deep expertise (based on seniority level) of enterprise business processes and financial metrics. Knowledge of standard ERPs (SAP, Oracle) and process areas (Inventory Management, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, Accounts Payable) is a strong plus.
Consulting skills: Ability to steer customer workshops, present findings to management, manage stakeholder expectations, and deliver outcomes in the face of adversity and ambiguity. Comfortable working with both technical and business audiences.

Eraneos ist eine internationale Beratungsgruppe für Strategie, Transformation und Technologie, die Unternehmen dabei unterstützt, in einer dynamischen digitalen Welt erfolgreich zu sein.

Mit erstklassigen Expertinnen und Experten aus Business und Technologie befähigen wir unsere Kunden, neue Massstäbe für nachhaltige Transformationen zu setzen - von der Strategie bis zur Umsetzung.

Ob bei der Gestaltung zukunftsfähiger Organisationen, der Erschliessung neuer Potenziale durch Daten und KI oder der Absicherung von Unternehmen durch ganzheitliche Cybersicherheit: Wir liefern Resultate pragmatisch und zielgerichtet.

Unser Team von rund 1-300 engagierten Mitarbeitenden ist in Büros in der Schweiz, Deutschland, den Niederlanden, Spanien, Portugal, Dänemark, Schweden, Österreich, Grossbritannien, Singapur und den USA vertreten und verbindet globale Perspektiven mit starken lokalen Wurzeln.

An den Schweizer Standorten Zürich, Bern und Lausanne arbeiten rund 450 Mitarbeitende.
# **Das ist der Job - Deine Hauptaufgaben** #
* Strategische Cross-Industry-Beratung bei der Implementierung neuer regulatorischer Vorgaben (Anforderungen definieren, Gap-Analyse durchführen, Handlungsfelder aufzeigen und Massnahmen umsetzen)
* Beratung unserer Kunden vorrangig in folgenden Rechtsgebieten: (Gen)AI Governance & Compliance, Vertrags- und Lizenzrecht, Contract Design, Datenschutz und Informationssicherheit, Third-Party-Risk-Management, Cybersecurity, FINMA-Vorgaben, etc. mit Fokus auf Fragestellungen im Zusammenhang mit digitaler Transformation
* Übernahme von Verantwortung in Teilprojekten sowie Unterstützung bei der Planung, Steuerung und Umsetzung komplexer Kundenprojekte
* Aktive Mitgestaltung beim Ausbau des internationalen Legal Strategy Teams
* Industrieübergreifende Projekttätigkeit mit der Möglichkeit, sich in einer Branche vertiefte Expertise aufzubauen
# **Dieser Job ist für dich, wenn** #
* Du erfolgreich ein Studium der Rechtswissenschaften oder Wirtschaftsrecht abgeschlossen hast.
* Du mind. 2 Jahre Erfahrung an der Schnittstelle von Recht, Technologie und IT hast und idealerweise bereits in Digitalisierungs-, Compliance-, Datenschutz-, Cybersecurity- oder Transformationsprojekten mitgearbeitet hast.
* Dich die praktische Anwendung rechtlicher Vorgaben mit technologischem Bezug (z. B. Datenschutzrecht, Informationssicherheit, Cloud, KI) begeistert.
* Du Freude daran hast, Projekte strukturiert voranzutreiben, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und perspektivisch Projektleitungsaufgaben zu übernehmen.
* Du überzeugend und strukturiert kommunizierst und du die Gabe hast, komplexe Konzepte und Sachverhalte zielgruppengerecht zu vermitteln.
* Du mündlich und schriftlich sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch kommunizierst (C1-Niveau).
# **Als i-Tüpfelchen bringst du mit** #
* Anwaltspatent (Schweiz)
* Zertifizierungen oder Weiterbildungen in Bereichen wie Datenschutz, Informationssicherheit, Cybersecurity, Projektmanagement, Legal Tech oder AI Governance
# **Was uns wichtig ist** #
Bei Eraneos zählt, was du bewegen willst. Auch wenn du nicht jede Anforderung vollständig erfüllst, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung. Uns interessiert dein Mindset, deine Ideen und der Impact, den du schaffen möchtest.
Vielfalt ist für uns eine Quelle von Wachstum und Inspiration. Wir freuen uns über jede Bewerbung.
Annalena Raich ist deine Ansprechperson und freut sich auf deine Direktbewerbung über unsere Webseite (CV, Diplome und Arbeitszeugnisse als PDF).
Bewerbungen per E-Mail oder über Personaldienstleister werden nicht berücksichtigt.

Job Title: Consultant, Change Management
Location: Remote; Northeast US required
Description
Founded in 2004, BME Strategies is a Massachusetts-based consulting firm specializing in the design, implementation, and evaluation of public health programs for local, regional, and state government partners.

Our work supports evidence-based, community-driven solutions that strengthen public health systems and advance equity across the communities we serve. At BME, our clients are on the front lines of Public Health. Priorities may shift but our commitment to supporting our partners does not.

We take pride in having multi-year, multi-project engagements, often working closely as an extension of their staff.

Our success comes from our shared values: a bias toward action; optimistically collaborative; willingness to navigate ambiguity; minimal ego - no job is too small or big; pursuing the equitable solution; always learning, and; committed to quality at every stage.

BME Strategies is seeking a Consultant, Change Management to lead our clients through the “people side” of organizational transformation. The person in this role will be a strategic partner to public health departments and nonprofits, moving beyond checklist-style project management to ensure that new policies, technologies (including AI), and protocols are deeply embedded and sustained by the workforce.
A key focus of this role is guiding local health partners through the adoption of AI-enabled tools and workflows, translating technical capability into practical, trusted practice on the ground. As an example, someone in this role may focus on why a deadline is missed, investigate human constraints like burnout or capacity gaps, and build the inclusive communication loops necessary to maintain organizational resilience.

Consultant roles at BME consist of approximately 85% project work, 5% administrative work, and 10% business development.
Leads or co-leads larger projects, technical and advisory, and contributes to project design.
Independently driving work with minimal day-to-day/project oversight.
May supervise Associates and Senior Associates.
Manages projects to exemplary client satisfaction.
Contributes to and/or leads proposals.

Transformation Leadership & Strategy: Lead the “People Side” of large-scale initiatives, ensuring that digital, operational, and AI-driven transitions are met with high adoption and minimal resistance.
Human-Centered Journey Mapping: Design and facilitate journey mapping sessions to identify friction points for frontline staff and stakeholders, ensuring implementation plans are grounded in the practitioner’s reality.
Strategic Stakeholder Engagement: Identify exactly who needs buy-in and partner with our Strategic Communications team to craft data-driven narratives that foster trust and alignment.
Workforce Development & Coaching: In partnership with our Workforce Development Team, provide hands-on coaching and upskilling to local leaders and staff, fostering long-term autonomy rather than temporary support.
Change Impact & Readiness Assessments: Conduct qualitative and quantitative assessments to evaluate organizational readiness and the magnitude of change, specifically within rural and urban health settings.
AI Change Management & Local Partner Support: Serve as a trusted advisor to local health departments, community health centers, and other local health partners as they adopt AI-enabled tools and workflows, translating technical AI capabilities into practical, human-centered guidance, addressing staff concerns about trust, data privacy, and job impact, and ensuring responsible, equity-centered adoption at the point of care and service delivery.
Embedded Liaison Services: Act as a primary point of contact for diverse coalitions, resolving operational issues by addressing the underlying human capacity needs.

Master’s degree in Public Health or a related field.
Minimum of 4-6 years of relevant experience required, including 2 or more years in a consulting firm environment
Experience in organizational change management or public health leadership and consulting.
Experience with health systems in Massachusetts or other Northeastern states (Maine, New Hampshire, Connecticut, Rhode Island, New York or New Jersey) is highly preferred.

As Commercial Strategy Analyst, you'll be part of the engine behind Halter's strategic decisions. You'll be building models, sizing opportunities, and running qualitative and quantitative analysis that shows us where to play. When the Commercial Strategy team needs to know whether a bet is worth making, they'll come to you to help build the case.
This is a role for someone who loves getting into the data and building up research. You'll turn ambiguous questions into clean, decision-ready analysis: market and opportunity sizing, scenario and sensitivity analysis, competitor analysis and broader industry trends. You'll make the complex feel simple, and give the team clear answers they can act on fast.
You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with Halter's commercial, finance, and product teams, supporting the initiatives that shape our future. You'll move between deep-focus analysis at your desk, pulling data from across the business, as well as getting out to meet farmers and ranchers so your thinking is grounded in reality.
This is a rare opportunity to build foundational analytical skills at one of the most transformative companies in agriculture - and to see your analysis directly shape major commercial decisions.

Corporate Development Manager
Ebury London Office - Hybrid: 4 days in the office, 1 day working from home per week

Ebury is growing on two fronts at once: organically, into new markets and customer segments, and inorganically, through acquisitions that add capability, licences and clients faster than we could build them ourselves. Corporate Development sits at the centre of both.
We're looking for an experienced management consultant to join the team in London. The role has two facets, and you will live through both.
In the first, you'll run internal strategic projects — end-to-end reviews of the processes that determine how well Ebury actually runs.

Client onboarding is the first of these: a journey that touches Sales, Compliance, Operations, Product and Technology across multiple jurisdictions, and where the difference between good and excellent is worth a great deal in conversion, cost-to-serve and client experience.

You will diagnose it properly, size the prize, design the target state, and then stay with it until something has genuinely changed.
In the second, you'll move onto integration work behind our acquisitions — turning a deal thesis into an operating reality across systems, people, clients and regulatory permissions.
This is a role for someone who wants to stop handing over the recommendation and start owning the outcome.

The Corporate Development team, with exposure to the CEO and Executive Committee
Functional leaders across Operations, Compliance, Finance, Sales, Product and Technology, Data and Legal
Counterparties, advisers and target management teams

Strategic Projects and Internal Transformation
Own end-to-end reviews of Ebury's core operating processes, beginning with client onboarding
Map the current state honestly — cycle times, drop-off points, rework, manual intervention, cost-to-serve — and quantify where value is lost
Look at the process across different customer segments and in different jurisdictions
Design the target state, sequence it into something deliverable, and build the business case behind it
Work through functional owners to land the change, then measure whether it actually landed
Corporate Strategy and M&A Support
Market mapping, target screening, and competitive and landscape analysis
Commercial and operational due diligence support: business model, unit economics, client base quality, operational scalability
Valuation and synergy modelling, and the business case behind a recommendation to proceed
Board, ExCo and investment committee materials
Post-Merger Integration
Plan and run integration workstreams across operating model, systems, people, clients and regulatory permissions
Day 1 readiness and the 100-day plan: what must be true, by when, and who owns it
Track synergy delivery against the assumptions underwritten at deal approval, and escalate early when they slip
Act as the bridge between what was assumed in the deal model and what is true on the ground
Analysis and Decision Support
Build the financial and operational models that inform capital allocation decisions
Turn ambiguous, under-specified questions into structured recommendations an executive team can act on

s.h: Bring a view. We are not looking for neutral summaries.
s.t:
What success looks like (12–18 months)
The onboarding review is delivered, and there is a measurable improvement in cycle time, conversion and cost-to-serve that can be attributed to it
Functional leaders treat you as a partner they call early, not a reviewer they manage around
You can lead an integration workstream independently, and are trusted to represent Ebury with a target's management team
Your analysis is used in decisions at ExCo and Board level, and holds up under challenge

You have no line authority. Every change you propose is delivered by a team that doesn't report to you and already has a roadmap. Influence, credibility and follow-through are the job.
Ebury is a regulated business in many jurisdictions. Elegant operating model solutions frequently die on a licensing, permissions or local supervisory constraint. You need to find that out early, not late.
The recommendation is the easy part. Unlike consulting, you don't leave after the readout. You own the implementation and the number.
The data is not clean. You will often build the view yourself rather than request it, and be able to defend how you built it.
The work is lumpy. Deal activity is unpredictable. You may be deep in a process review one week and in a data room the next, and you need to be able to hold both.

Prior M&A or integration experience is a plus, not a requirement. We are looking for someone with genuine consulting craft, strong commercial instincts and the agency to operate without a partner above them defining the workplan.

4–7 years of management consulting experience, ideally at a Big 4 firm (Deloitte, PwC, KPMG, EY) or a comparable strategy or transaction advisory practice
A track record of owning workstreams end to end — problem definition, analysis, recommendation and client sign-off
Strong analytical toolkit: structured problem solving, financial modelling, advanced Excel, comfort working with imperfect data
Executive-grade written and verbal communication, including PowerPoint that survives a Board audience
Degree in a numerate or analytical discipline (Engineering, Economics, Business, Sciences or similar)
Fluent English, with daily collaboration across global commercial, technology and Legal/Compliance/Risk stakeholders

Exposure to financial services, payments, FX or lending
Post-merger integration, carve-out or operational due diligence experience
Experience redesigning regulated operational processes such as onboarding, KYC or credit
SQL, or fluency with BI and analytics tooling
An additional European language (Spanish, Portuguese, French, Dutch, German or Italian)

Structured Problem Solving — breaks down open-ended, under-defined questions into a workplan; sizes the opportunity before designing the fix.
Commercial Judgement — understands how operational decisions land in revenue, margin and risk; prioritises on business impact rather than analytical interest.
Delivery Bias — measures success by what changed, not by what was presented; stays with a project past the readout.
Influence Without Authority — builds credibility with functional owners quickly, and gets change delivered through teams that don't report to them.
Comfort with Ambiguity — operates without a defined workplan or a partner above them; high agency, low need for structure.
Intellectual Honesty — reports the finding that is inconvenient, including when it kills their own recommendation.
Regulatory Literacy — willing to get into the detail of licensing, permissions and compliance constraints rather than treating them as someone else's problem.

We are looking for great people to join our team of energy consultants. You would be based in our Madrid office, working in our consulting activities in the power modelling sector for Iberia and Latam . Joining an experienced team from which you will learn the details of the Mexican/Chilean nodal market through long-term market modelling, transaction, bespoke client scenarios, renewable storage and policy analysis among many other client projects.
As part of our Madrid consulting team you will also have the opportunity to collaborate regularly with colleagues around other offices like Bogota, Bangkok, Beijing, Berlin, Dubai, Dusseldorf, Helsinki, London, Oxford, Milan, New York, Oslo, Paris, Stockholm, Vienna, and Zurich.
The challenges of decarbonisation, decentralisation and digitalisation require us to continually challenge our existing ideas to remain at the forefront of thinking on the future of the energy industry. Our vision is to be the most recommended advisor for the energy transition. If you are as interested as we are in this dynamic industry, we would love to hear from you.
You will have the opportunity to gain knowledge and experience to become an industry specialist within a stimulating and supportive environment. Our team specialises in all aspects of the energy transition. We offer strategic and commercial advice, develop policy and regulations, model systems and markets and support transactions. We pride ourselves on our in-depth analysis and strong client relationships.
Often the work is office based but there are many opportunities to travel for shorter trips for client meetings or for entire projects where work is on the client site.

With more than 800 consultants across over 20 offices on 5 continents, and supported by 19,000 experts at AFRY in design, engineering and digitalisation, we are driven by the idea of helping our clients find solutions to business-critical questions. For individuals looking for international experience, we can also offer secondments to other offices.
As a primary responsibility, you will support AFRY consulting activities for a wide range of clients – including major financial investors, the largest Iberian and international utilities, government, and regulatory bodies – through projects carried out mainly in Spain, Portugal and Latin America.

We currently have two open one to support in the Mexican power market and another one to support in the Chilean and Iberian markets, collaborating with both teams. If you are as interested as we are in this dynamic industry, we would love to hear from you.

A Master’s degree , or higher, in maths, engineering, economics or science related subject
0 to 3 years of proven experience either from university projects or work on topics such as: any energy field (e.g. trading, renewable energies, retail markets, networks etc.)
any business practice (e.g. transactions, management consulting, engineering etc.)
Good knowledge and a strong interest in electricity markets with a plus on experience in aspects of the Mexican, Chile or Iberian power market such as: Energy trading , PPAs , asset valuations, system planning, market modelling
M&A , project financing, plant dynamics, energy economics,
Advanced analytical and quantitative skills . We undertake a lot of complex analysis, a good proportion of which is numerical, so we are looking for people with an aptitude for complex quantitative and qualitative analysis, statistics, manipulation of large data and diverse mathematical models.

This includes the ability to pay attention to detail and use MS Excel proficiently, understanding programming logic, data bases, visualisation tools (Tableau or PowerBI) and creative problem-solving skills.
Excellent team working . All the work we do requires team working. This involves planning the work, supporting the team, anticipating challenges, leading by example, and accountability towards the client (with more Senior support when required).
Being fluent in Spanish and English. On the one hand our clients are located in Spanish and non-Spanish speaking countries, and on the other hand our work requires day-to-day collaboration – in English – with other AFRY offices.
Writing and communication skills . Report-writing and presenting in public is a core part of our work, therefore we are also looking for the ability to explain complex information in a clear and logical way in English, both in writing and orally.
Proactivity and responsibility . You will be working in a commercial environment against budgets and deadlines so you will need to be able to think for yourself, be proactive and have a business-oriented mindset.
Passion for energy markets and policies. You have a holistic understanding of electricity or gas market dynamics, sustainability challenges, and energy policies.

computer programming (e.g. Python, Optimisation languages, VBA etc.)

Pour accompagner le déploiement de l'IA agentique chez ses clients et en interne, Sia recrute un(e) consultant(e) Agent Builder .
L'Agent Builder conçoit, industrialise et fait adopter des agents IA : assistants métiers, automatisations multi-étapes, copilotes intégrés aux outils du client. Le poste est à la fois technique et fonctionnel : vous traduisez un besoin métier en agent qui fonctionne réellement en production , et vous en démontrez la valeur.
Au sein d'une équipe de consultants expérimentés et en plein essor, vous accompagnerez nos clients notamment sur les missions suivantes :
Échanger avec les différentes parties prenantes pour identifier, qualifier et prioriser les cas d'usage agentiques à fort impact
Concevoir l'architecture d'un agent : découpage des tâches, choix du modèle, outils et connecteurs, mémoire, garde-fous et points de contrôle humain
Construire et itérer sur des agents avec les plateformes du marché (Microsoft Copilot Studio, Claude, Azure AI Foundry, OpenAI, LangGraph, n8n, Google AgentSpace, …etc.)
Réaliser le prompt engineering et le context engineering : instructions système, découpage des skills, intégration des sources de connaissance (RAG, SharePoint, bases documentaires)
Intégrer les agents au SI du client via API, MCP et connecteurs métiers (Microsoft 365, CRM, ERP, ITSM)
Évaluer et fiabiliser : jeux de tests, mesure de la qualité des réponses, détection des régressions, suivi des coûts et de la latence
Sécuriser le déploiement : gestion des droits et des données, traçabilité, conformité au cadre réglementaire applicable et aux politiques IA du client
Accompagner l'adoption : formation des utilisateurs, documentation, transfert de compétences aux équipes du client
Dans le cadre des activités internes du cabinet, votre participation s'articule autour des axes suivants :
Contribuer à la construction de nos offres et de nos accélérateurs sur l'IA agentique
Capitaliser sur les agents, skills et briques réutilisables développés en mission
